en.t: I was simply in awe of the Master.

units.source_text: 那次以后，一连四天一早起床，名人就来喊我打台球，打了一整天。

en.t: After that, for four days in a row, as soon as I got up early in the morning, the Master would come and call me to play billiards, and we played all day long.

units.source_text: 甚至打到深夜，天天如此。

en.t: We even played late into the night, and it was like that every day.

units.source_text: 他岂止是天才，简直是超人啊。”

en.t: He was far more than a genius; he was practically superhuman.
